question: Who is authorized to conduct road tests on workshop vehicles?
solution:
The correct answer is __Only trained and certified personnel**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Only trained and certified personnel__ are authorized to conduct road tests on workshop vehicles.
 
• This ensures the safe and proper handling of vehicles during testing.
 
• Other individuals, including visitors or non-trained employees, are not permitted to perform such tests.
 
• Workshop vehicles are often subject to specific operational protocols and require skilled handling.
 
• The certification process ensures that personnel possess the necessary skills and knowledge to identify and rectify issues effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Role of Certification:**

 
 
• Certification ensures that personnel understand the safety protocols and technical requirements of road testing.
 
• It includes training in vehicle diagnostics, handling, and operation.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Road Tests:**
 
 
• Road tests are conducted to verify the performance of repaired or maintained vehicles.
 
• They help identify any remaining issues or confirm the vehicle's safety and functionality.
